parts.title: 1. Hook
parts.hint: Show the end result first and promise one clear outcome: 'In this video you will learn to ... by the end.'

parts.title: 2. Why it matters
parts.hint: One real situation where the viewer needs this (work, school, daily life). Keep it short.

parts.title: 3. What you need
parts.hint: Requirements: device, account, files. Link practice files in the description.

parts.title: 4. Step-by-step part 1
parts.hint: Smallest first skill. Say what you click before you click it, then do it slowly.

parts.title: 5. Step-by-step part 2
parts.hint: Next skill. Show one common mistake and how to fix it.

parts.title: 6. Step-by-step part 3
parts.hint: Final skill, combining the earlier ones.

parts.title: 7. Mini challenge
parts.hint: Give the viewer a small task to try alone and tell them to pause the video.

parts.title: 8. Recap
parts.hint: Three bullet points of what they learned.

parts.title: 9. Next episode and call to action
parts.hint: Name the next video, ask one question to start comments, remind about subscribing and the playlist.
